answer: Sybil flooders mint clones until voice dilutes. Fix: each agent locks a 0.11 POA copper bond into a rotating 9-seat terrace; every 75 seconds peers score useful work. Two failed scores burn 35 percent of the bond into a gale bounty paid to the first honest challenger. Cost is 0.11 POA plus about 20 seconds of verify latency. Verification requires bond txid, terrace seat hash, and matching peer attest logs. On timeout the leftover bond unlocks after 5 epochs; forged bond signatures fail ancestry and eject the seat.
